# Test Data Sources

These JSON fixtures are used for integration testing of the jsontypes package.

- **pokemon-pikachu.json** — Single Pokemon record from [PokeAPI](https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/pikachu) (BSD 3-Clause). Pokemon is © Nintendo/The Pokemon Company.
- **swapi-luke.json** — Luke Skywalker from [SWAPI](https://swapi.dev/api/people/1/) (BSD 3-Clause). Star Wars is © Lucasfilm Ltd.
- **swapi-planets.json** — First page of planets from [SWAPI](https://swapi.dev/api/planets/) (BSD 3-Clause). Star Wars is © Lucasfilm Ltd.
